Holy Basil (Tulsi)

Remedy tulsi adaptogen stress blood-sugar

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Sacred adaptogenic herb that reduces stress, supports blood sugar regulation, and enhances mental clarity.

Indications

  • stress
  • anxiety
  • high blood sugar
  • cortisol excess
  • cognitive support

Contraindications

  • extract
